title: Kicking or banning a player now changes the join link
summary: A removed player could sign out and come back as another unclaimed character with the link they already had. Kicking or banning now replaces the room's join link, and a removed account can no longer claim a seat.
items: After a kick or ban, Share join link and Copy session code give the new link at once; the old one stops working.
Seated players keep playing with nothing to do.
A banned account cannot join or link a seat again, signed in or not; a kicked player rejoins through Copy fresh invitation.
